services.name: Scenic Tours
services.desc: With over 250+ five star reviews on Airbnb, Google, and Tripadvisor, you are GUARANTEED to have a unique, memorable, and fun flight! Our passengers have included first dates, marriage proposals, anniversaries, first time flyers, birthday surprises, tourists, locals looking for adventure, grandparents, children, newborns, pretty much anyone wanting to make some great memories! Save yourself four hours in the car and fly in style to the Boneville Speedway known internationally for it’s many land speed records. Enjoy taking in the scenery above the 5,000 year old salt flats. blurb: Guests can experience backcountry flying in Utah with scenic tours, flight training including tailwheel and high performance endorsements, and air taxi services to various destinations. The service uses specialized bush planes like the Cessna 170B and 182B equipped for rough strips and short take-offs. Customized backcountry airplane camping trips and safety pilot services are also available.
